sourceFiles.description: All {@link Genai.SourceFile}s to be synced belonging to the same collection.

chunkerSpec.description: Chunker to use during processing. If no chunker is provided, {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.Universal} will be used as default.

lastProcessedBy.description:
The {@link User#email} who last processed this source file.
This is used in {@link Genai.SourceFile#displayLastProcessedBy} to display the last processed activity in UI.
The entire {@link User} is not persisted to avoid access issues with ACLs.
The refresh could either be triggered manually or by the cron job.

title: Used by {@link Genai.SourceFile.Job.SyncBatchJob} to supply the {@link Genai.SourceFile}s, {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.UniversalChunker.Spec}
